latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the api-gateway skill by Maton.

- Provides a secure passthrough proxy for direct access to over 100 third-party APIs via managed OAuth connections.
- Supports connection management (list, create, get, delete) via a separate controller endpoint.
- Requires MATON_API_KEY for authentication; all API calls are scoped to user-authorized connections.
- Includes detailed usage instructions for native API calls, specifying connections, and environment setup.
- Proxies popular APIs including Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, GitHub, Notion, Slack, Airtable, HubSpot, and more.
